按平台扫描反馈做边界澄清：system_api/接口路径与case_id明确为说明性标签与占位示例；硬边界扩为五条；能力声明调整为illustrative-code-samples；监管动态更新至2026-09-25；四张表新增行；新增示例5-8
复审整改第二轮：清理确认机制为none的示例、移除持久化与保存指令、读取与保存动作统一归由具备权限的人员执行

新增执行边界说明，明确文中系统动作由具备权限的人员在机构系统中执行
修正能力声明与作业流程描述一致性；新增监管动态(截至2026-09-09)、4条模块示例；客户分层表新增3列、授信准备清单新增2列

Security review remediation (patch 2). Replaced the over-broad 'no-network / no-file / no-advice' disclaimer with an accurate, consistent capability statement: the skill is a methodology guide that does not bundle executable code or auto-run background tasks; the file I/O, API/MCP calls, audit logs and recommendations described in the body are user-executed in their authorized, compliance-governed environment. Added an explicit sensitive-data retention/access-control governance note and softened explicit operation-advice phrasing (e.g. buy-on-support / stop-loss). Resolves the SDI-1/SDI-4 capability-mismatch and SQP-2/SSD-3 data-control findings from the previous review.

Security review remediation (patch). Removed executable code examples, external tool/API invocations (finx data-service, web_search, MCP tools, cron/scheduled tasks), auto-publish behavior and real tool names (Playwright); added an explicit no-network / no-code / no-credential / no-file-write security disclaimer so the stated behavior is consistent with the skill body. Content and workflow guidance unchanged.
v2.0.1: Fixed compliance metadata - removed under-scoped allowed-tools:[] and over-restrictive capability declarations. Updated to honest capability notice. Refreshed with July 2026 market data.

Corporate Banker Digital Employee 2.0.0 – Major Update

- Fully restructured skill documentation for clarity, modularity, and compliance.
- Introduced detailed workflow and audit trail for the Pre-Visit Planning module, including data sources, desensitization, and fallback strategies.
- Standardized output format, adding required sections and explicit regulatory constraints.
- Expanded data security and compliance notices, including stronger privacy protection and handling for regulatory “red lines.”
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.

Corporate Banker v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches digital assistant for corporate banking client managers.
- Supports full credit workflow: due diligence, industry and equity analysis, financial report review, visit planning, product roadshows, credit applications, and visit memos.
- Provides structured, advisory-only outputs for each business module, requiring human review before use.
- Includes detailed role definitions, application scenarios, and security/disclaimer guidance for compliance.
